title: John Harbaugh blasts NFL for flag on Cam Skattebo for lowing his helmet: 'That's the way you're supposed to run'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh blasts NFL for flag on Cam Skattebo for lowing his helmet: 'That's the way you're supposed to run'
sources.description: In a game where violence is the point, the NFL has yet to come up with a satisfactory player safety measure that doesn't legislate the football out of football.
